command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd appsvc >/dev/null; then
  useradd --system --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /usr/sbin/nologin --user-group appsvc
fi
CHROOT_DIR=/srv/chroot/webapp
install -d -m 0755 "$CHROOT_DIR/app" "$CHROOT_DIR/usr/bin" "$CHROOT_DIR/usr/lib" "$CHROOT_DIR/lib" "$CHROOT_DIR/lib64" "$CHROOT_DIR/etc"
cp -a /usr/bin/python3.12 "$CHROOT_DIR/usr/bin/"
ln -sfn python3.12 "$CHROOT_DIR/usr/bin/python3"
cp -a /usr/lib/python3.12 "$CHROOT_DIR/usr/lib/"
ldd /usr/bin/python3.12 | awk '/=> \/|^\// {for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) if ($i ~ /^\//) print $i}' | while IFS= read -r lib; do
  install -d "$CHROOT_DIR$(dirname "$lib")"
  cp -L "$lib" "$CHROOT_DIR$lib"
done
printf 'appsvc:x:%s:%s:Application Service:/nonexistent:/usr/sbin/nologin\n' "$(id -u appsvc)" "$(id -g appsvc)" > "$CHROOT_DIR/etc/passwd"
printf 'appsvc:x:%s:\n' "$(id -g appsvc)" > "$CHROOT_DIR/etc/group"
printf 'hosts: files dns\n' > "$CHROOT_DIR/etc/nsswitch.conf"
printf '127.0.0.1 localhost\n' > "$CHROOT_DIR/etc/hosts"
chown -R root:root "$CHROOT_DIR"
chmod -R go-w "$CHROOT_DIR"
printf 'created appsvc uid=%s gid=%s\n' "$(id -u appsvc)" "$(id -g appsvc)"
chroot "$CHROOT_DIR" /usr/bin/python3 --version
find "$CHROOT_DIR" -maxdepth 2 -type d -printf '%M %u:%g %p\n' | sort
